name: Rhian
about: Rhian (class 1042), the weaver: widow of Toran the gem cutter and mother of Torwin; runs Toran's shop after the execution (specs/world/leveling_facts.md 6). Virtues topic (PLAN-VIRTUES.md 3.2 and 3.3; feature virtues): helping Toran's family with obsidian (Sacrifice, Compassion), once.

topics.label: Toran's family
say: You were on the dock that morning. I saw you. Most people looked away.
We manage. The shop still sells a little. Some weeks it does not.

topics.label: Take these 20 obsidian. For the family.
cant_pay: You reach for your purse and find too little in it to offer. Rhian pretends not to notice.
say: I... I cannot refuse it. Not this winter.
Thank you, stranger. Toran would have liked you. He always said the kind ones come from far away.
I... I cannot refuse it. Not this winter.
Thank you, Avatar. Toran would have liked you. He always said the kind ones come from far away.

topics.label: I am sorry for your loss.
say: So are many. Sorrow does not buy bread, but it is kind of you to say it.

topics.label: Toran was a thief. His family gets what it deserves.
say: Rhian's face goes white. She says nothing at all, and turns back to her loom.
You hear her weeping before you reach the door.
